name: k4-d3
comment: The only known graph of matching index >= 3 (Krenn-Gu-Zeilinger 2017, Figure 4 of arXiv:2407.00303): K4 whose three perfect matchings are the three colour classes of a 1-factorisation. Reproducing dimension 3 here is the gate this problem's search code has to pass before it is trusted.
